$comment: Example Open Tray rules. Copy to <your repo>/.claude/tray.json, or to ~/.claude/open-tray/rules/<repo folder name>.json to keep them out of the repo. Paths are from the repo root. {1} is the area's number padded by 'pad'; {1n} is the plain number; {each} is a folder matched by an action's 'each'.

actions.label: Preview {each}
actions.prompt: Start a preview server for {each} and put its URL in the Open Tray.
